The force data match a freely jointed chain, but the clamp readout needs the finite-\(N\) endpoint distribution—not simply the inverse of the force-extension curve. I’m checking that distinction against the apparatus definition before implementing it, since it materially affects hidden clamp cases.

I’m doing a final review for numerical edge cases and API compatibility.

The edge-case review caught and isolated a units error in the clamp derivative: the polynomial is differentiated in \(x/b\), so the logarithmic slope needs one additional \(1/b\) factor. I’m correcting that and rerunning the checks.
